Study Area

Location:
Phelps County, Nebraska, USA

Latitude Range:
40.35°N – 40.68°N

Longitude Range:
99.64°W – 99.17°W

Reason for Selection:
Phelps County has long-term groundwater monitoring stations available through the USGS National Water Information System (NWIS), making it suitable for groundwater analysis.

Source:
USGS National Water Information System (NWIS)
